title: Disc Selection Guide — Choosing the Right Hole Style
description: How to select the correct disc hole style based on part geometry and contact requirements.

decision_criteria.condition: Round parts with a single center hole
decision_criteria.recommendation: DS1 hole style — single center hole provides reliable contact for round parts with existing center holes

decision_criteria.condition: Parts with two mounting holes or that need bilateral contact
decision_criteria.recommendation: DS2 hole style — double center hole pattern for parts needing two-point contact

decision_criteria.condition: Parts with three mounting points or that need distributed contact
decision_criteria.recommendation: DS3 hole style — triple offset pattern distributes contact for better anodize coverage

decision_criteria.condition: Square or rectangular parts
decision_criteria.recommendation: DS4 hole style — quad-corner pattern matches rectangular geometries

decision_criteria.condition: Flat panels needing maximum contact distribution
decision_criteria.recommendation: DS5 hole style — radial 6-point pattern provides the most even contact distribution for flat panels

decision_criteria.condition: Variable-width parts or parts that change width between batches
decision_criteria.recommendation: DS6 hole style — adjustable slot pattern accommodates varying part widths

title: Disc Size Selection Guide
description: How to select the correct disc diameter based on part size.

decision_criteria.condition: Parts smaller than 2" in any dimension
decision_criteria.recommendation: 2.0" disc — smallest available standard disc

decision_criteria.condition: Parts 2"–3" in size
decision_criteria.recommendation: 3.0" disc

decision_criteria.condition: Parts 3"–4" in size
decision_criteria.recommendation: 4.0" disc

decision_criteria.condition: Parts 4"–5" in size
decision_criteria.recommendation: 5.0" disc

decision_criteria.condition: Parts 5"–7" in size
decision_criteria.recommendation: 6.0" disc

decision_criteria.condition: Parts 7"–9" in size
decision_criteria.recommendation: 8.0" disc

decision_criteria.condition: Parts 9"–11" in size
decision_criteria.recommendation: 10.0" HD disc (HD only)

decision_criteria.condition: Parts 11"+ in size
decision_criteria.recommendation: 12.0" HD disc (HD only)

general_rule: Disc diameter should be approximately equal to or slightly larger than the largest dimension of the part being anodized.

title: Clip Selection Guide — When to Use Clips Instead of Discs
description: Guidance on when clips are more appropriate than disc mounting.

decision_criteria.condition: Part has no flat surface for disc contact
decision_criteria.recommendation: Use clips — CL2 (screw-adjust) or CL3 (wide-jaw) depending on part thickness

decision_criteria.condition: Part is irregularly shaped (not round, square, or rectangular)
decision_criteria.recommendation: Use clips — specifically CL5 (alligator) for textured surfaces or CL6 (flat-face) for cosmetic parts

decision_criteria.condition: Part has existing holes that can serve as hanging points
decision_criteria.recommendation: Use hooks — HK1 (S-hook) for through-holes, HK2 (J-hook) for edge hanging

decision_criteria.condition: Part is tubular
decision_criteria.recommendation: Use HK3 (ring hook) — designed specifically for tubular parts

decision_criteria.condition: Part is very small (< 0.25" in any dimension)
decision_criteria.recommendation: Use CL4 (micro clip) — designed for parts too small for standard clips

decision_criteria.condition: Part surface must not be marked
decision_criteria.recommendation: Use CL6 (flat-face clip) — minimizes contact marks on cosmetic surfaces

title: Rack Frame Selection Guide
description: How to choose the right frame size for your production needs.

decision_criteria.condition: Low volume, small parts, prototyping, or tank width < 8"
decision_criteria.recommendation: 191-FR2 Small Frame (2 spines) — 6" wide, holds up to 2 spines

decision_criteria.condition: Medium volume production, tank width 8"–14"
decision_criteria.recommendation: 191-FR4 Medium Frame (4 spines) — 12" wide, holds up to 4 spines

decision_criteria.condition: High volume production, tank width 14"+
decision_criteria.recommendation: 191-FR6 Large Frame (6 spines) — 18" wide, holds up to 6 spines

decision_criteria.condition: Need more than 6 spines or custom tank dimensions
decision_criteria.recommendation: Use Frame-to-Frame Connectors (191-RC3) to gang multiple frames together. Contact Sequel at 800-553-8273 for custom configurations.

title: Standard vs. Heavy-Duty Selection Guide
description: When to use standard discs vs. HD discs.

decision_criteria.condition: Parts weigh 2.5 lbs or less each
decision_criteria.recommendation: Standard discs (0.125" thick) — sufficient strength at lower cost

decision_criteria.condition: Parts weigh between 2.5 and 5.0 lbs each
decision_criteria.recommendation: HD discs (0.187" thick) — 50% thicker for increased load capacity

decision_criteria.condition: Parts weigh more than 5.0 lbs
decision_criteria.recommendation: Contact Sequel at 800-553-8273 for custom heavy-duty solutions

important_note: HD discs require HD spine bolts (999020) and HD spine nuts (999021) — standard spine bolts are too short for the thicker disc.
